title: Atropos taint model entry
description: One row of taint knowledge, keyed by a resolvable symbol and an access path. Modeled after the models-as-data shape: a declarative fact the engine binds against a code graph. Pure data; no engine coupling.

role_group.description: The taint role every entry in this file carries.

id.description: Stable unique key. Dotted, lowercase. e.g. c.mem.memcpy.n

package.description: Module/package that owns the symbol. null for a C standard-library / builtin name.

type.description: Owning type for a method (e.g. a DB cursor). null for a free function.

method.description: Function or method name as the frontend resolves it.

signature.description: Human-readable signature. Documentation only; binding keys on symbol + access_path, not this.

access_path.description: Where the role attaches: Argument[n], ReturnValue, Receiver, or in->out for a summary.

kind.description: Vulnerability class subtype. e.g. buffer-write, buffer-size, command-injection, sql-injection, code-injection, deserialization, format-string, path-traversal, alloc-size, network-input.

cwe.description: Public CWE identifiers for the class. Standard names, not sourced data.

confidence.description: Our confidence that this attachment is a true positive when the flow reaches it.

corroboration.description: How many independent confirmations back this entry. A count only; establishes it as fact rather than one author's expression.
